2608.20970.title: Deep Learning Models Also Recall Features
2608.20970.paper_summary: Recent work in mechanistic interpretability has studied how large language models recall facts stored in their weights. This paper argues that factual recall points to something broader: a general kind of operation in deep learning models, which I call feature recall. The core observation is that a linear projection can be read as retrieving stored information scaled by input activations. I define feature recall, show it applies across architectures, and contrast it with the established paradigm of feature combination. I also consider how cases of feature recall might be mechanistically identified. The account gives philosophers a new conceptual tool for understanding deep learning, and points to empirical directions for mechanistic interpretability research.
2608.20970.paper_summary_zh: 最近在機械解釋性方面的研究探討了大型語言模型如何回憶其權重中儲存的事實。這篇論文主張，事實回憶指向更廣泛的東西：一種我稱之為特徵回憶的深度學習模型中的一般操作。核心觀察是，線性投影可以被解讀為檢索由輸入激活縮放的儲存信息。我定義了特徵回憶，展示它在不同架構中的適用性，並將其與已建立的特徵組合範式進行對比。我還考慮了如何在機械上識別特徵回憶的情況。這一說明為哲學家提供了一種新的概念工具，以理解深度學習，並指向機械解釋性研究的實證方向。
2608.20970.author: Pierre Beckmann et.al.
